news.title: Trump’s Grand Midterm Convention Finale: ‘I’m a Little Bit Tired of Politics’
news.summary: The president made clear as his midterm convention wrapped up that he wants to carry his party through a tough midterms. He just won’t go too far out of his way to do it.
